header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
None present for the petitioner; nor intimation received.
body: This petition was filed in year 2019 with the prayer that respondent No.2 be directed to restore the VISA of the petitioner and her son Emad and allow them to go Azerbaijan. Since 2019, the petitioner is not pursuing this petition, which reflects that grievance of the petitioner has now been redressed, therefore, instant petition has become infructuous, hence same is hereby disposed of.
